retirement_guidance: Do not add new strategy to docs/archive.
Replace old release guards with current capability tests before moving their required audit files.
Keep DOC_INDEX.md as the human navigation map and this JSON as the Admin Docs report source.
Use short build-sync notes in retained audit files rather than copying the full roadmap into each file.
current_app_position: Connected lead/quote → booking → live interaction → proof → payment → review → maintenance foundation.
Live updates now connect to queued notifications, unread state, resilient uploads, proof gates, customer recommendation decisions, and linked incidents.
Completed-job summaries, approved-media reuse, safe review gating, and Today Needs Attention are available after the Build 210 migration.
Routine content uses friendly editors; raw JSON remains emergency-only.
Desktop/mobile visual, gallery, incident, payment, accounting, SEO, and media diagnostics are present.
remaining_doc_risk: Historical audit files remain at the root because release guards still depend on them. New strategy must go only into AI_PROJECT_HANDOFF.md and MASTER_VALUE_ROADMAP.md.
